headline: UK Office for National Statistics Releases October Retail Sales Time Series Data
summary: The UK Office for National Statistics published its first estimates of Great Britain retail sales volumes and values for October 2026.
why: The Office for National Statistics is the executive office of the UK Statistics Authority, producing official national macroeconomic indicators.

impacts.name: UK Retail Sector
impacts.why: The ONS published first estimates of retail sales volumes and values in Great Britain for October.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
